new_result.name: canonical_active_blocker_compression
new_result.statement: For a width-at-most-three heavy cover x<.y with a incomparable to x,y, every bad x<->a middle swap is witnessed by one of at most three canonical Hasse blockers and every bad a<->y swap by one of at most three canonical Hasse blockers. Exact blocker weights partition the bad-event families. Two distinct canonical blockers carry total assigned incidence at least Pr(x<a<y)-1/3. If strict strong-majority span descent is absent, all canonical blockers lie outside the majority interval x prec_* a prec_* y.
new_result.partner_amplification: If c is the maximum minority probability of the canonical channel pairs and h=Pr(x<a<y), fleet01/B10 TP2 gives 3c-c^2 >= (3h-1)/2, hence c >= (3-sqrt(11-6h))/2.
new_result.scope: arbitrary finite size, width at most three, original uniform full-extension law

preserved_failure: No different-anchor positive-association claim is used; the adaptive selector degenerates as h decreases to 1/3 and therefore does not close POS3.
